risk_summary: The disclosure identifies substantial clinical, regulatory, financing, collaboration, pandemic, and impairment risks, including development costs exceeding $100 million per candidate and potential need for additional capital. Although it provides some quantified historical spending and trial details, much of the forward-looking discussion relies on broad contingencies and omitted or truncated tables, limiting visibility into timing, cash needs, and program-level outcomes.
